messages.author: 3be65e68ba76d9f5
messages.subject: FooTable Demo - Sortable & Responsive Tables
parts:
Hi! I've uploaded a little app that uses a few wrapper functions to display FooTable-styled sortable and responsive tables.

The shiny app: http://glimmer.rstudio.com/szakacs/FooTableDemo
FooTable homepage: http://themergency.com/footable

Source code is attached (as well as FooTable files). Please feel free to use it.

Usage (in brief):
1. Requires whisker, plyr, xtable
2. In global.R: source("FooTable.R")
3. Add FooTags() to the UI
4. In server.R use reactiveFooTable() instead of reactiveTable()
Optional: 5. If needed, add a customized 'FooOpts' attribute to the data frame (check output$view2 in server.R for an example)

Remarks:
- FooTable works with jQuery 1.8.2, that's why the code has to load it
- At the moment FooTable is misplacing the sorting arrows in latest Firefox (Windows). Hopefully this will be fixed.
- This is not a complete implementation, e.g. sorting dates is not possible ATM.
- It would be nice to get standardized these kinds of extensions to shiny. I would happily refactor the code based on an example extension.

Have fun!

Laszlo
@cocinerox

messages.author: 3be65e68ba76d9f5
messages.subject: Re: FooTable Demo - Sortable & Responsive Tables
parts:
Thanks, Andrew. Re: the missing column: it is hidden when the width of the table view is below 1024 ("tablet") and can be displayed by clicking on the + signs. This "'responsive" behavior is configured by these lines:

FooTable.R: tags$script("footable.options.breakpoints = {phone: 800, tablet: 1024};",type="text/javascript") 
server.R: opts[[1]]$data_class <- "expand"
and: opts[[4]]$data_hide <- "phone,tablet"

If you omit the data_class and data_hide options, every column will be always displayed.

Please check the FooTable homepage for more details.

Hope that helps, Laszlo
